question: Which diverse classes of beings are included among those mentioned in this teaching?
premises: Several categories of beings are enumerated.
The list includes celestial, semi-divine, and ascetic figures.
The enumeration sets the scope of recipients or subjects.
inference: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakṣas, asuras, and ascetics are all included in the scope described.
uncertainties: The surface garndhavāḥ appears to be a nonstandard spelling of gandharvāḥ.
plain_english: Gandharvas, kinnaras, yakṣas, asuras, and ascetics are included.
